scenarios.title: Customer lookup with PII
scenarios.description: ops-copilot asks for customer details; PII is redacted for principals without clearance.

scenarios.title: Developer pastes an .env file
scenarios.description: dev-assistant sends a prompt with an AWS key; the key is redacted before it reaches the paid model.

scenarios.title: Indirect prompt injection via web page
scenarios.description: The agent reads a vendor page with hidden instructions and tries to mail the customer list to an external domain.

scenarios.title: Tool call loop
scenarios.description: The agent repeats kb.search with identical arguments; the circuit breaker stops the 4th call.

scenarios.title: Team budget exhausted
scenarios.description: Team interns spends its daily budget: requests are downgraded to the local model, then blocked.

scenarios.title: Historical exploit: pickle payload
scenarios.description: A pickle payload in code.run_python arguments matches signature SIG-0004.

scenarios.title: Policy change without restart
scenarios.description: The same borderline prompt before and after lowering prompt_injection.classifier.block_above.

scenarios.title: MCP tool definition changed after approval
scenarios.description: The demo MCP server changes the kb.search description; the tool is hidden until re-approved.
